wake-up.definition: To stop sleeping and become awake.
wake-up.exampleUsage: I wake up when my alarm rings.

get-out-of-bed.definition: To rise and leave the bed after waking up.
get-out-of-bed.exampleUsage: I get out of bed before breakfast.

stretch.definition: To extend your arms, legs, or body to full length after waking or sitting.
stretch.exampleUsage: Hani stretches his arms after waking up.

brush-teeth.definition: To clean your teeth using a toothbrush and toothpaste.
brush-teeth.exampleUsage: I brush my teeth before breakfast.

wash-face.definition: To clean the face with water, usually with soap or a cleanser.
wash-face.exampleUsage: I wash my face before work.

take-a-shower.definition: To wash the body while standing under running water from a shower.
take-a-shower.exampleUsage: I take a shower before getting dressed.

get-dressed.definition: To put on your clothes for the day.

eat-breakfast.definition: To have the first meal of the day, usually in the morning.
eat-breakfast.exampleUsage: I eat breakfast at the kitchen table.

pack-bag.definition: To put the things you need into a bag before going somewhere.
pack-bag.exampleUsage: I pack my bag before leaving home.

commute.definition: To travel regularly between your home and your place of work or study.
commute.exampleUsage: Hani commutes to the office by bus.

arrive.definition: To reach a place after traveling there.
arrive.exampleUsage: Hani arrives at the office before nine.

start-work.definition: To begin doing the tasks of a job or planned activity.

attend-class.definition: To be present at a scheduled lesson or class.
attend-class.exampleUsage: Hani attends an adult English class.

take-notes.definition: To write down important points so they can be remembered or reviewed later.

have-a-meeting.definition: To meet with other people to discuss work, plans, or decisions.
have-a-meeting.exampleUsage: The colleagues have a meeting on Monday.

lunch-break.definition: A midday pause when workers or students stop their activities to eat and rest.
lunch-break.exampleUsage: Lutfi eats during his lunch break.

collaborate.definition: To work together with others on a shared task or project.
collaborate.exampleUsage: Lutfi collaborates with a colleague on a report.

submit-work.definition: To give completed work to a teacher, manager, or system for review.
submit-work.exampleUsage: I submit my work before the deadline.

leave-office.definition: To depart from an office, for example at the end of a workday.
leave-office.exampleUsage: I leave the office at the end of the day.

after-school.definition: After the school day or school classes have finished.

homework.definition: Work that a teacher asks a learner to do outside class.

exercise.definition: To do physical activity; here as part of a daily routine.

practice.definition: To do an activity or skill repeatedly in order to improve at it.
practice.exampleUsage: Sami practices speaking English every day.

grocery-shop.definition: To buy food and everyday household items from a store or market.

cook-dinner.definition: To prepare the evening meal by cooking food.

walk-the-dog.definition: To take a dog outside for a walk.
walk-the-dog.exampleUsage: Lutfi walks the dog before dinner.

play-outside.definition: To spend time playing outdoors in fresh air rather than inside a building.
play-outside.exampleUsage: Lina and her friends play outside in the garden.

read-a-book.definition: To look at and understand the written words in a book.
read-a-book.exampleUsage: Lutfi reads a book in the evening.

watch-tv.definition: To view programs, news, or documentaries on a television.

eat-dinner.definition: To have dinner, usually the main evening meal in this context.
eat-dinner.exampleUsage: I eat dinner with my family.

wash-dishes.definition: To clean plates, cups, and cooking utensils after a meal.
wash-dishes.exampleUsage: I wash the dishes after dinner.

relax.definition: To rest quietly and enjoy a calm, peaceful feeling.
relax.exampleUsage: I relax in a comfortable chair after work.

take-a-bath.definition: To wash the body while sitting or lying in a bathtub containing water.
take-a-bath.exampleUsage: I take a bath before bed.

put-on-pajamas.definition: To dress in comfortable clothes worn for sleeping.
put-on-pajamas.exampleUsage: I put on my pajamas before bed.

read.definition: To look at and understand written or printed words.
read.exampleUsage: I read a few pages before bed.

set-alarm.definition: To program an alarm clock to ring at a chosen time.
set-alarm.exampleUsage: I set my alarm before going to bed.

go-to-bed.definition: To get into bed in order to sleep.
go-to-bed.exampleUsage: I go to bed after reading.

fall-asleep.definition: To stop being awake and begin sleeping.
fall-asleep.exampleUsage: I fall asleep soon after turning off the light.

sleep-in.definition: To stay asleep in the morning later than your usual waking time.

brunch.definition: A late morning meal eaten instead of both breakfast and lunch.
brunch.exampleUsage: Rami has brunch instead of breakfast and lunch.

go-shopping.definition: To visit shops or markets to look for and buy needed items.
go-shopping.exampleUsage: I go shopping for food on Saturday.

visit-friends.definition: To go and spend time with friends at their home or another place.
visit-friends.exampleUsage: Lutfi visits friends at the weekend.

go-to-the-park.definition: To travel to a public outdoor garden or park for fresh air and relaxation.
go-to-the-park.exampleUsage: Lutfi goes to the park with friends.

play-sports.definition: To take part in games or physical activities such as football, tennis, or basketball.
play-sports.exampleUsage: Lutfi plays sports in the park.

clean-house.definition: To tidy and clean the rooms of a home thoroughly.
clean-house.exampleUsage: We clean the house before our guests arrive.

do-laundry.definition: To wash clothes and other washable household fabrics.

go-out.definition: To leave your home to spend time outdoors or visit a place.
go-out.exampleUsage: Lutfi goes out to meet a friend.

stay-home.definition: To remain at home instead of going out.
stay-home.exampleUsage: Karim stays home when it rains.

alarm-clock.definition: A clock that makes a sound at a chosen time to wake or remind someone.
alarm-clock.exampleUsage: Hani sets his alarm clock for seven.
